title: One discarded prefix can complete the route.
summary: Independent replay verifies one full-route continuation from three fixed discarded roots. Two searches exhaust their remaining work without completion; neither miss is proved inevitable. Every queried state passes scalar replay.
boundary: Fresh conditional trees do not establish an integrated win. Qualification remains 3/4 and source comparison stays closed. Twelve audited prefix records remain unprobed. Actual-history intervention and measured response delay remain unestablished.
next: Qualify deterministic retention of an additional eligible branch, then run the original four cases with unchanged budgets and explicit lost-success accounting. Avoid targeting the known successful root.
